baseMatrix.note: Frozen v1.1 audit kit bytes (SHA256SUMS, MANIFEST.json); K01–K32 ids, levels and original oracles stay there unchanged. This overlay is the current contract version (MAC-14, verification §6.2).

entryPoints.tests: CONTRACT_TESTS in the runner: one or more [test file, name pattern] entries per contract; every entry must select and pass at least one test
entryPoints.realJdt: scripts/release-jdt-contracts.mjs inside scripts/run-isolated-jdt-benchmark.mjs; evidence schema release-real-jdt-evidence/v2 passed with --jdt-evidence

K03.setup: MCP through one isolated owner daemon
K03.oracle: unchanged business assertions: ambiguous without sourceSet, main/test selected by sourceSet

K05.setup: MCP through the owner; real FSEvents tracker
K05.oracle: waits for the correct answer at the new content hash; names the workspace and capture (snapshotId, contentManifestId) of both answers

K06.setup: six linked git worktrees of one family started together through one owner
K06.oracle: each worktree answers only from its own Java and XML content (same paths, different hashes); before its own verified binding it refuses as NOT_READY, never from a sibling or a building snapshot; six workspaces, six captures; request-view: a workspace without its own verified binding is NOT_READY

K11.setup: MCP through the owner; real watcher refresh
K11.oracle: named method ID survives the move; selection/evidence/preview at the new range and hash; the explicit call fact stays and moves with its caller in the new snapshot; names workspace and capture

K12.setup: MCP zero-deadline rejection plus the real IndexOwner request view
K12.oracle: nonzero budgets bound resolve, workspace create, prepare, SQL in query workers and preview; external elapsed within deadline + 1 s; a handler outliving its deadline loses its view and snapshot lease, and the superseded snapshot is reclaimed

K15.oracle: as K05: correct text at the new hash from the edit's capture

K19.oracle: as K05 for add, rename and delete: each answer from its own new capture

K20.setup: real IndexOwner request view and owner GC
K20.oracle: hits, then a publish of a new snapshot, then status/coverage/anchor/preview on the same held lease; preview of a changed or deleted captured file is a sourceChanged gap; GC keeps the superseded snapshot while leased and reclaims it within two cycles after release

K21.setup: a twin worktree seed-bound to the sibling's sealed snapshot
K21.oracle: XML-only modify, then delete, in the twin: one path delta each, logical digest equal to the twin's own full, the twin's XML hash, the sibling's binding and XML unchanged; no VACUUM INTO (ledger D01)

K24.setup: integrity test plus the real IndexOwner request view
K24.oracle: a FAILED/RECOVERED Java file and a normal update publish together: the update is visible, an affected negative is DEGRADED; after the repair coverage is COMPLETE

K26.setup: real frozen JDT inside one isolated owner over a detached fixture clone, stdio relay
K26.oracle: disabled: explicit --enable-lsp error, status unstarted; enabled: locator selections resolve declarations, references bind Caller.java:5:23; two linked worktrees with the same URIs and different content answer concurrently from their own content in distinct sessions, then through 12 interleaved rounds (both issue orders, declaration and call site) with 0 crosstalk (G16); missing real JDT is BLOCKED_ENV

K28.oracle: a 1 ms caller exits by deadline while the long caller's shared work stays in flight; deltas of the owner's semantic gateway: one shared join, one backend completion, no abort; inflight returns to 0

K29.oracle: fixed 1000-file request-path load gate; real lishu-v2 cold/seed/full pressure is G11 and does not substitute

K30.setup: real snapshot store, query pool and owner GC
K30.oracle: a sealed snapshot has no WAL/SHM/journal sidecar; reader, query, base and publication leases keep their snapshot through sweeps until release; worker leases follow open connections; superseded snapshots physically go after release under continuous publishes; not only a WAL checkpoint

heartbeat: builder liveness: a real child of at least 5 s judged by first arrival, adjacent arrival gaps and last arrival; liveness beats are separate from work progress

retired.src/benchmark/release-index-contracts.te: legacy in-process SqlJavaIndexClient/LocalBuilder versions of K03/K06/K11/K20/K21/K30; their business assertions moved to the entries above; K23 stays there
